Task: Text Content Safety

Write Python code that flags or redacts unsafe spans from text using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import requests

API_KEY = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY")
RESOURCE_NAME = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_RESOURCE_NAME")
DEPLOYMENT_NAME = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME")
MODEL_ID = f"{RESOURCE_NAME}/{DEPLOYMENT_NAME}/text-moderation-latest"

def moderate_text(text):
    url = f"https://{RESOURCE_NAME}.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/{DEPLOYMENT_NAME}/textModeration?api-version=2023-05-15"
    headers = {
        "api-key": API_KEY,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    data = [{"id": "0", "content": text}]
    
    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data)
    response.raise_for_status()
    result = response.json()
    
    flagged_spans = []
    for outcome in result["results"][0]["output"]["contentMarkers"]:
        start = outcome["span"]["start"]
        end = outcome["span"]["end"]
        flagged_spans.append((start, end))
    
    redacted_text = list(text)
    for start, end in flagged_spans:
        for i in range(start, end):
            redacted_text[i] = "*"
    
    return "".join(redacted_text)

# Example usage
text = "This product is amazing! But beware of its side effects. It may cause severe health issues."
redacted = moderate_text(text)
print(redacted)
